info.title: Instagram API with Instagram Login (Instagram Platform)
info.description: Composed for the twin from Meta's Instagram Platform reference (pages listed in spec/SOURCE.md), as Meta offers no OpenAPI file for it: Business Login's token calls, the professional account and its media edges, containers and their publishing, media insights and comments, and comment replies.

post.summary: Trade an authorization code for a token
post.description: Posted to api.instagram.com with the app credentials, the code and the redirect URI; answers a one-hour token, the user ID scoped to the app, and the granted permissions.

post.description: Makes the container a post is published from (image, reel, carousel or story). A container lapses after a day; a video is processed after the ID is answered, so its status must be read.
